etym.text: Formé de 'en-' et de 'presser' (du latin 'pressare', presser, serrer); l'adjectif 'empressé' en est le participe passé.

reasons: etym reversed derivation: empresser is the base verb, not derived from the adjective empressé (which is its past participle)
